Daily settlement prices and open interest from CME Globex statistics

Source: R/cme.R
cme_statistics.Rd

Reduces Databento statistics records for the CME Globex dataset (GLBX.MDP3) to one row per instrument and trading date: the settlement price, its status, open interest, and cleared volume.

Usage

cme_statistics(x, tz = "America/Chicago", price_scale = 1)

Arguments

x

A data.frame of statistics records, or path(s) to Parquet (needs the arrow package) or CSV files, or directories.

tz

Exchange time zone used only for the ts_ref fallback (default "America/Chicago").

price_scale

Multiplier applied to price (default 1, for files with decimal prices; use 1e-9 for raw fixed-precision integers).

Value

A tibble of class cme_statistics with columns instrument_id, date (trading date), settle, settle_final (logical), settle_flags, open_interest, volume (cleared volume).

Details

Which settlement. The exchange publishes several settlement messages per instrument and session: preliminary values first, the final value last (and occasionally re-sends). Bit 0 of stat_flags marks a final price (bit 1: actual rather than theoretical; bit 2: rounding to the trading tick, or an unrounded preliminary price for products that are not rounded; bit 3: intraday). For each instrument and trading date the function keeps the last final message; if no final message exists, it keeps the last preliminary one and sets settle_final = FALSE.

Trading date. The trading date is the exchange's trading reference date (ts_ref), used at date precision without time-zone conversion. Where ts_ref is missing, the publication time ts_event is converted to the exchange time zone and weekend publications are assigned to the preceding Friday session; messages with a reference date take precedence over such fallback messages.

Deletions and undefined values. A record with update_action = 2 deletes the statistic: earlier records for the same instrument, type, and date are discarded. Quantities equal to the 64-bit integer maximum mean "undefined" and become NA.

References

Databento documentation of the statistics schema and of the CME Globex MDP 3.0 dataset (GLBX.MDP3), https://databento.com/docs/schemas-and-data-formats/statistics.

See also

cme_definitions(), cme_option_surfaces().

Examples

st <- data.frame(
  instrument_id = 11,
  ts_event = as.POSIXct(c("2016-06-01 19:00", "2016-06-01 21:40",
                          "2016-06-01 23:40"), tz = "UTC"),
  ts_ref = as.POSIXct("2016-06-01", tz = "UTC"),
  stat_type = 3,
  price = c(0.0101, 0.0102, 0.0102),
  stat_flags = c(4L, 2L, 3L)   # preliminary, actual preliminary, final
)
cme_statistics(st)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   instrument_id date       settle settle_final settle_flags open_interest volume
#>           <dbl> <date>      <dbl> <lgl>               <int>         <dbl>  <dbl>
#> 1            11 2016-06-01 0.0102 TRUE                    3            NA     NA
